blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 1997 年的背景： 1990 年代，製藥業電腦化浪潮洶湧。工廠裡的 SCADA 系統、LIMS、MES 開始大量取代紙本記錄，但 FDA 法規（如 21 CFR 211.188 批次記錄）仍寫「書面記錄」和「手寫簽名」。這個落差造成法規不確定性——電子記錄到底算不算合規？Part 11 就是填補這個空白的法規。
blocks.en: The 1997 context: In the 1990s, computerization swept through the pharmaceutical industry. SCADA systems, LIMS and MES began to replace paper records on a large scale, yet FDA regulations (such as 21 CFR 211.188 on batch records) still referred to "written records" and "handwritten signatures". This gap created regulatory uncertainty: were electronic records acceptable for compliance purposes or not? Part 11 is the rule that filled that gap.

blocks.zh: 等效性原則 (Equivalence Principle)： Part 11 不是要求用電子方式，而是說：如果你選擇用電子方式，符合 Part 11 的電子記錄就等同於紙本記錄。這是一個「許可」框架，不是「強制」框架。
blocks.en: Equivalence principle: Part 11 does not require you to use electronic methods. It says that if you choose to use them, an electronic record that meets Part 11 is equivalent to a paper record. It is a "permissive" framework, not a "mandatory" one.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 Part 11 比作「電子合約的公證標準」：你要簽合約，可以手寫在紙上，也可以用電子簽名平台（如 DocuSign）。電子方式不是強制的，但如果你選擇電子方式，必須符合一定的安全標準（身份驗證、防竄改、時間戳記），才具備法律效力。Part 11 就是 FDA 版的這套標準。
blocks.en: Think of Part 11 as the "notarization standard for electronic contracts". To sign a contract, you can write on paper or use an e-signature platform (such as DocuSign). Electronic methods are not mandatory, but if you choose them, they must meet certain security standards (identity verification, tamper resistance, time stamps) to have legal effect. Part 11 is FDA's version of that standard.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ★ Part 11 適用範圍的關鍵字：「under any requirements set forth in agency regulations」——必須是其他 FDA 法規要求留存的記錄，Part 11 才管。
blocks.en: ★ The key phrase for Part 11 scope is "under any requirements set forth in agency regulations": Part 11 governs a record only if another FDA regulation requires that record to be kept.

blocks.zh: ★ 電子化傳輸的紙本記錄不適用：若公司保存紙本批次記錄為官方記錄，只是掃描成 PDF 用電子郵件傳送，Part 11 不適用於該 PDF（§11.1(b) 明文排除「紙本記錄的電子傳輸」）。
blocks.en: ★ Paper records transmitted electronically are not covered: if a company keeps paper batch records as the official records and merely scans them to PDF and sends them by email, Part 11 does not apply to that PDF (§11.1(b) expressly excludes "electronic transmission of paper records").

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 使用紙本批次記錄，並在完成後掃描上傳至 SharePoint。這個 SharePoint 系統需要符合 Part 11 嗎？
blocks.en: A CDMO uses paper batch records and, once complete, scans and uploads them to SharePoint. Does this SharePoint system need to comply with Part 11?

blocks.zh: 同一個 CDMO 現在改用 eBR（電子批次記錄）系統，操作員直接在平板上輸入數據並電子簽名。現在需要符合 Part 11 嗎？
blocks.en: The same CDMO now switches to an eBR (electronic batch record) system, where operators enter data directly on a tablet and sign electronically. Does Part 11 apply now?

blocks.zh: 0.2 The "Predicate Rule" Concept 0.2 「前提規則」概念
blocks.en: 0.2 The "Predicate Rule" Concept

blocks.zh: Predicate Rule（前提法規）判斷樹：
blocks.en: Predicate rule decision tree:

blocks.zh: 問題 1：有另一條 FDA 法規要求這筆記錄存在嗎？→ 否 → Part 11 不適用（即使記錄是電子的）
blocks.en: Question 1: Does another FDA regulation require this record to exist? → No → Part 11 does not apply (even if the record is electronic)

blocks.zh: 問題 2：這筆記錄是電子形式建立/維護的（而非紙本掃描）？→ 否 → Part 11 不適用
blocks.en: Question 2: Is the record created/maintained in electronic form (rather than a scan of a paper record)? → No → Part 11 does not apply

blocks.zh: 問題 3：公司選擇電子記錄作為官方記錄？→ 否 → Part 11 可能不完全適用（2003 指引裁量空間）
blocks.en: Question 3: Has the company chosen the electronic record as its official record? → No → Part 11 may not fully apply (room for discretion under the 2003 guidance)

blocks.zh: 全部是 → Part 11 適用
blocks.en: All yes → Part 11 applies

blocks.zh: Predicate Rule 就像「主法」，Part 11 是「配套技術規範」。主法（如 21 CFR 211.188）說「你要有批次記錄」；Part 11 說「如果你用電子方式留這批次記錄，必須做到以下這些」。沒有主法要求，Part 11 無從附著。
blocks.en: The predicate rule is like the "parent rule", and Part 11 is the "supporting technical specification". The parent rule (such as 21 CFR 211.188) says "you must have a batch record"; Part 11 says "if you keep that batch record electronically, you must meet the following requirements". Without a predicate rule requirement, Part 11 has nothing to attach to.

blocks.en: CDMO Practical Notes

blocks.zh: Amaran Biotech 實例： 假設 Amaran Biotech 為客戶執行無菌充填，使用以下系統：
blocks.en: Amaran Biotech example: Suppose Amaran Biotech performs aseptic filling for clients and uses the following systems:

blocks.zh: eBR 系統（Veeva Vault MES）：predicate rule = §211.188（批次記錄）→ Part 11 適用
blocks.en: eBR system (Veeva Vault MES): predicate rule = §211.188 (batch records) → Part 11 applies

blocks.zh: LIMS（LabWare）：predicate rule = §211.194（實驗室記錄）→ Part 11 適用
blocks.en: LIMS (LabWare): predicate rule = §211.194 (laboratory records) → Part 11 applies

blocks.zh: SCADA（Emerson DeltaV）：predicate rule = §211.68（電腦化設備數據）→ Part 11 適用
blocks.en: SCADA (Emerson DeltaV): predicate rule = §211.68 (automatic, mechanical and electronic equipment data) → Part 11 applies

blocks.zh: BMS（溫濕度監控）：predicate rule = §211.68 + FDA Aseptic Guidance EM data → Part 11 適用
blocks.en: BMS (temperature and humidity monitoring): predicate rule = §211.68 + EM data under the FDA Aseptic Guidance → Part 11 applies

blocks.zh: HR 系統（員工薪資）：無 FDA predicate rule → Part 11 不適用
blocks.en: HR system (employee payroll): no FDA predicate rule → Part 11 does not apply

blocks.zh: 0.3 FDA 2003 Guidance: Narrowed Enforcement Scope 0.3 FDA 2003 年指引：縮小執法範圍
blocks.en: 0.3 FDA 2003 Guidance: Narrowed Enforcement Scope

blocks.zh: 2003 指引的歷史背景： 1997 年 Part 11 發布後，業界反應是「太嚴苛了」。特別是對在 1997 年前就已運作的老舊系統（legacy systems），要求完全合規會造成巨大財務和運作負擔。FDA 在 2003 年發出指引，說：「我們理解，對於遺留系統，我們不會只因為技術上不符合某些條款就採取法規行動。」但這是「執法裁量 (enforcement discretion)」，不是「免除義務 (exemption from regulation)」。
blocks.en: Background to the 2003 guidance: After Part 11 was issued in 1997, industry's reaction was that it was "too strict". This was especially true for older systems already operating before 1997 (legacy systems), where requiring full compliance would impose a huge financial and operational burden. In 2003, FDA issued guidance stating, in effect: "We understand that, for legacy systems, we will not take regulatory action solely because they technically fail to meet certain provisions." However, this is "enforcement discretion", not an "exemption from regulation".

blocks.zh: ★ Legacy System 認定條件（兩者都要）： (1) 1997 年 8 月 20 日前就已在使用；AND (2) 以紙本為官方記錄，電子記錄只是補充。現代製藥廠幾乎很少有真正的「遺留系統」——大多數系統已更新換代，或已完全電子化，不符合「以紙本為官方記錄」的條件。
blocks.en: ★ Criteria for a legacy system (both must be met): (1) the system was already in use before August 20, 1997; AND (2) paper is the official record and electronic records are only supplementary. Modern pharmaceutical plants rarely have a true "legacy system": most systems have been replaced or upgraded, or are fully electronic, and so do not meet the "paper as the official record" condition.

blocks.zh: ★ Part 11「不強制」的重要性： 如果 FDA 查廠時，你的電子記錄系統不符合 Part 11，FDA 不能只憑「違反 Part 11」就開 483。必須是違反了底層的 predicate rule（如批次記錄不完整 = §211.188 違規）。但 Part 11 違規通常暗示數據完整性問題，可能升級為 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: ★ Why it matters that Part 11 is "not mandatory": If your electronic record system does not meet Part 11 during an FDA inspection, FDA cannot issue a Form 483 solely for "violating Part 11". There must be a violation of the underlying predicate rule (for example, an incomplete batch record = §211.188 violation). However, a Part 11 deficiency usually points to a data integrity problem and can escalate to a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: 0.4 Part 11 and ALCOA+ Data Integrity Alignment 0.4 Part 11 與 ALCOA+ 數據完整性的一致性
blocks.en: 0.4 Part 11 and ALCOA+ Data Integrity Alignment

blocks.zh: ALCOA+ 與 Part 11 的關係： ALCOA+ 是 WHO/FDA/MHRA 等監管機構在數據完整性指引中反覆強調的原則框架；Part 11 是針對電子記錄/簽名的具體 FDA 法規。兩者並非替代關係，而是互補關係：
blocks.en: How ALCOA+ relates to Part 11: ALCOA+ is the principles framework that regulators such as WHO, FDA and MHRA repeatedly emphasize in their data integrity guidance; Part 11 is the specific FDA regulation for electronic records and signatures. The two are not substitutes but complementary:

blocks.zh: ALCOA+ 告訴你「數據應該是什麼樣子」（概念層）
blocks.en: ALCOA+ tells you "what the data should look like" (conceptual layer)

blocks.zh: Part 11 告訴你「電子系統要做到哪些具體控制」（實施層）
blocks.en: Part 11 tells you "what specific controls an electronic system must have" (implementation layer)

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 告訴你「如何用驗證流程實現 Part 11 要求」（方法層）
blocks.en: GAMP 5 tells you "how to meet Part 11 requirements through the validation process" (methodology layer)

blocks.zh: 查廠應對技巧 Inspection Tips
blocks.en: Inspection Tips

blocks.zh: 當 FDA 查廠官員問「你們如何確保數據完整性？」時，可以用 ALCOA+ 框架作答，然後具體指出每個元素如何在你的 Part 11 系統中實現。這種結構化回答比只說「我們有 Part 11 驗證系統」更有說服力。
blocks.en: When an FDA investigator asks "How do you ensure data integrity?", you can answer using the ALCOA+ framework and then point out specifically how each element is implemented in your Part 11 systems. This structured answer is more convincing than simply saying "we have a Part 11 validated system".

blocks.zh:
範例回答框架：
「我們的 eBR 系統通過 Part 11 驗證。針對 Attributable：系統要求每位操作員使用個人帳號（§11.10d），簽名顯示完整姓名、時間戳和簽名意義（§11.50）。針對 Original：所有數據由系統自動時間戳記錄，稽核追蹤由系統產生，用戶無法修改（§11.10e）…」
blocks.en:
Sample answer framework:
"Our eBR system has been validated for Part 11. For Attributable: the system requires each operator to use an individual account (§11.10(d)), and signatures show the full printed name, time stamp and meaning of the signature (§11.50). For Original: all data are automatically time-stamped by the system, and the audit trail is system-generated and cannot be modified by users (§11.10(e))..."

blocks.zh: 如果一個 LIMS 系統的稽核追蹤可以被系統管理員關閉，違反了 ALCOA+ 的哪個原則？對應 Part 11 的哪個條款？
blocks.en: If a LIMS audit trail can be switched off by the system administrator, which ALCOA+ principle is violated? Which Part 11 provision does it correspond to?

blocks.zh: 「紙本記錄可以是 Original 嗎？」在 ALCOA+ 和 Part 11 的框架下，分別如何解釋？
blocks.en: "Can a paper record be Original?" How is this explained under the ALCOA+ and Part 11 frameworks, respectively?

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Part 11 不強制電子化： 只規定「如果選擇電子記錄/電子簽名，必須符合這些標準」。紙本永遠是合規選項。
blocks.en: Part 11 does not mandate electronic records: It only specifies that "if you choose electronic records/electronic signatures, you must meet these standards". Paper is always a compliant option.

blocks.zh: Predicate Rule 是適用前提： 沒有另一條 FDA 法規要求留存的記錄，Part 11 不適用。判斷系統是否受 Part 11 規範，先找 predicate rule。
blocks.en: The predicate rule is the precondition for applicability: If no other FDA regulation requires the record to be kept, Part 11 does not apply. To decide whether a system is subject to Part 11, first find the predicate rule.

blocks.zh: 2003 指引縮小執法範圍： 1997 年前的遺留系統（以紙本為官方記錄）享有執法裁量空間，但現代 CDMO 系統通常不符合遺留系統條件。
blocks.en: The 2003 guidance narrowed the scope of enforcement: Legacy systems that predate 1997 (with paper as the official record) enjoy enforcement discretion, but modern CDMO systems usually do not meet the legacy system criteria.

blocks.zh: ALCOA+ 與 Part 11 互補： Part 11 的具體技術要求（稽核追蹤、驗證、存取控制）直接對應 ALCOA+ 各元素；兩個框架一起使用，建立完整的數據完整性論述。
blocks.en: ALCOA+ and Part 11 are complementary: The specific technical requirements of Part 11 (audit trails, validation, access control) map directly to the ALCOA+ elements; used together, the two frameworks build a complete data integrity argument.
